26.name: Tyrice Knight
26.comment: Knight (hip) doesn't have an injury designation for Monday's game against the Bears, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

27.name: Tykee Smith
27.comment: Smith recorded seven tackles (four solo) and an interception in Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

27.name: Zyon McCollum
27.comment: McCollum recorded five tackles (four solo) and two interceptions in Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

27.name: Alex Anzalone
27.comment: Anzalone posted two solo tackles and an interception during the Buccaneers' 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.

27.name: Josiah Trotter
27.comment: Trotter recorded eight tackles (five solo) during the Buccaneers' 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.

27.name: Kameron Johnson
27.comment: Johnson played all 17 of his snaps on special teams and recorded one tackle in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

27.name: Ted Hurst III
27.comment: Hurst failed to haul in his lone target during the Buccaneers' 27-24 loss to the Bears on Sunday.

27.name: Tez Johnson
27.comment: Johnson caught two passes for 76 yards on five targets in Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

27.name: Sean Tucker
27.comment: Tucker didn't log any offensive snaps in a loss to the Bears on Sunday. He returned four kickoffs for 92 yards.

27.name: Chase McLaughlin
27.comment: McLaughlin converted all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during Tampa Bay's loss to the Bears on Sunday.

27.name: Cade Otton
27.comment: Otton caught four of eight targets for 25 yards in Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

27.name: Yaya Diaby
27.comment: out

27.name: Bucky Irving
27.comment: Head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that the Buccaneers "will try and lessen the load" on Irving following their Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

27.name: Jalen McMillan
27.comment: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

27.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
27.comment: Godwin caught two of three targets for 16 yards and added a 12-yard rush during Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

27.name: Kenny Gainwell
27.comment: Gainwell rushed five times for 16 yards and caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

27.name: Baker Mayfield
27.comment: Mayfield completed 18 of 32 passes for 243 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears. He also rushed once for no gain and ran in a two-point conversion.

27.name: Emeka Egbuka
27.comment: Egbuka (foot) caught three of five targets for 38 yards and added a one-yard run in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

27.name: Antoine Winfield Jr.
27.comment: Winfield (ankle) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday night's contest against the Bears.

27.name: Tristan Wirfs
27.comment: Wirfs (toe) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Bears.

27.name: Jacob Parrish
27.comment: Parrish registered seven total tackles (four solo) and two passes defensed, including an interception, during Sunday's 16-0 win over Atlanta.

27.name: Bauer Sharp
27.comment: Sharp went without a target while playing 19 of the Buccaneers' 60 snaps on offense in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

10.name: Tommy Townsend

10.name: Peter Skoronski

10.name: Anthony Hill Jr.
10.comment: Hill (neck) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

10.name: Chimere Dike
10.comment: Dike may have a significant role on offense with Carnell Tate (shoulder) ruled out for Sunday's game against Jacksonville.

10.name: Tony Pollard
10.comment: Pollard (finger/rest) was a full participant in Friday's practice and doesn't carry an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

10.name: Tyjae Spears
10.comment: Spears (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars after upgrading to full practice participation Friday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

10.name: Carnell Tate
10.comment: Tate (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

10.name: JC Latham
10.comment: Latham (finger) practiced in full Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

10.name: Jaylon Jones
10.comment: Jones (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

10.name: Marcus Harris
10.comment: Harris (ankle) practiced in full Wednesday.

10.name: James Williams Sr.
10.comment: The Titans placed Williams (groin) on injured reserve Monday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

10.name: Dorian Mausi
10.comment: The Titans activated Mausi (foot) from injured reserve Monday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

10.name: Nicholas Singleton
10.comment: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that Singleton is "getting better," and the rookie running back could be a candidate to see added opportunities in the second half of the season if lead back Tony Pollard is dealt ahead of Tuesday's deadline, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

10.name: Calvin Ridley
10.comment: Titans head coach Robert Saleh confirmed Monday that Ridley was involved in an "unfortunate" interaction over the weekend at Nashville International Airport that is now in the hands of law enforcement, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

10.name: Joey Slye
10.comment: Slye hit both field-goal tries and his two extra-point attempts in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

10.name: Elic Ayomanor
10.comment: Ayomanor caught three of five targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

10.name: Gunnar Helm
10.comment: Helm caught five of nine targets for 76 yards during Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

10.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
10.comment: Robinson caught six of seven targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He also lost a fumble.

10.name: Cam Ward
10.comment: Ward completed 26 of 40 passes for 304 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He added seven rushing attempts for 41 yards, lost a fumble, ran in a two-point conversion and threw a successful two-point conversion.

10.name: John Franklin-Myers
10.comment: Franklin-Myers (groin) is active for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

28.name: Jeremy Reaves
28.comment: Reaves recorded nine tackles (seven solo), one pass defense and one fumble recovery during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

28.name: Nick Cross
28.comment: Cross finished Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants with six tackles (one solo).

28.name: Frankie Luvu
28.comment: Luvu recorded six tackles (two solo) and a forced fumble during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

28.name: Sonny Styles
28.comment: Styles recorded 13 tackles (five solo) during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

28.name: Drew Stevens
28.comment: Stevens made his only field-goal attempt and was successful on all three of his extra-point tries in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.

28.name: Ben Sinnott
28.comment: Sinnott caught all four of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown Thursday in a 24-21 victory against the Giants.

28.name: Treylon Burks
28.comment: Burks caught two of three targets for 27 yards Thursday in a 24-21 win over the Giants.

28.name: Antonio Williams
28.comment: Williams secured both targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

28.name: Austin Ekeler
28.comment: Ekeler rushed nine times for 26 yards and brought in all four targets for 26 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

28.name: Rachaad White
28.comment: White rushed 11 times for 47 yards and brought in one of two targets for five yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

28.name: Stefon Diggs
28.comment: Diggs secured six of 10 targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

28.name: Jayden Daniels
28.comment: Daniels completed 23 of 33 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed 11 times for 28 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

28.name: Chig Okonkwo
28.comment: Okonkwo (back) returned to Thursday's eventual 24-21 win at the Giants, finishing with four catches (on eight targets) for 24 yards.

28.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
28.comment: Kaliakmanis (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against the Giants but will serve as the team's emergency quarterback.

28.comment: inactive

28.comment: inactive

28.comment: inactive

28.name: Colson Yankoff

28.name: Van Jefferson

28.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
28.comment: Newton (pectoral) is active for Sunday's game against the Rams.
